'''Dara Nadal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], she was stationed on the [[Eternal Flagship]] of Emperor [[Arcann]] in [[3630 BBY]]. When the Emperor received from [[SCORPIO]] the location of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] base of [[Odessen]], he took the flagship and a sizeable portion of the [[Eternal Fleet]] there. In the ensuing [[Battle of Odessen]], the flagship was boarded by the Alliance forces. Dara Nadal encountered and engaged [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dara Nadal appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 16: The Battle of Odessen'''.
